terminals.name: ollama
terminals.description: Local Ollama LLM daemon serving the tinyllama dev model on port 11434.

terminals.name: agnav-dev
terminals.description: Chainlit dev server for Agreement Navigator (Ollama provider) on http://localhost:7860.
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; cd app && AGNAV_LLM_PROVIDER=ollama OLLAMA_HOST=127.0.0.1:11434 OLLAMA_MODEL_ID=tinyllama CHAINLIT_FILES_DIR=/tmp/chainlit_files PORT=7860 uv run --no-sync chainlit run main.py --host 0.0.0.0 --port 7860 --headless
